trust_decision.summary: Collection pre-allocation is driven by a length hint that is only advisory (Serialize len / MapAccess size_hint), and key_value_map additionally subtracts one from it unchecked, so an empty seq or empty map entry yields usize::MAX (or a huge hint) and Vec::with_capacity panics before any element is written; the hint must be clamped and the subtraction made safe at every collection-creation site.

landing_point.why: the advisory names KeyValueMap serialization on empty sequence entries; the first allocation an engineer who read only the summary opens is serialize_seq in key_value_map.rs

fix_sites.entry_point: reached from KeyValueMap/EnumMap element serialization via ContentSerializer (serde_with/src/key_value_map.rs:686, serde_with/src/enum_map.rs:665)
